leads.snippet: Fitness is the one industry where customers actually enjoy using the product. Help us tell that story well. At Sport Alliance, we're looking for someone who can bring clarity to our product portfolio and help us connect the right products with the right customers across different markets. Every one of our products needs a clear reason to exist, a clear customer and a clear story. You’ll work alongside Product from the earliest sizing and segmentation conversations through to launch and adoption, so what we build is what the market wants and what Sales can sell.
